criteria.name: Coins balance
criteria.target: Every coin accounted for, every hour
criteria.detail: 580 of 580 runs balanced to the coin.

criteria.name: Shocks recover
criteria.target: Watched prices back in band within 30 days

criteria.name: NPCs stay small
criteria.target: Under 10% of trade value in calm

criteria.name: No flicker
criteria.target: At most 2 spawns per market, role and week
criteria.detail: Worst case 2 spawns in a week; median share of market-weeks over 2: 0.00 %.

criteria.name: Treasury holds
criteria.target: Never negative; drifts under 25% in calm
criteria.detail: Median baseline drift -9%; lowest balance in any run 540,184.

criteria.name: Prices steady
criteria.target: Basket inflation under 2% a week and 15% over the run
criteria.detail: Median basket change -12% over the run.

criteria.name: Cheap start
criteria.target: Starter kit in under 2 hours of play
criteria.detail: Median 1.0 hours (starter quest); buying one at market would take 10.1.

criteria.name: Stabilizer earns its keep
criteria.target: Recovers at least 2x faster than with it off
criteria.detail: 33 of 200 pairs recovered faster with it on.

criteria.name: Token reachable
criteria.target: Top earners under 20h, median under 60h per token
criteria.detail: Median 11h for top earners, 37h for the median player.

criteria.name: Fair pay
criteria.target: Every focus earns 0.5x-2x the average per hour
criteria.detail: Outside the range (median): Carpenter x0.03, Tailor x0.07, Repairer x0.08, Hauler x0.16, Miner x0.21, Logger x0.26, Hunter x0.34, Smith x0.38, Alchemist x2.98.

scenarios.name: Miners quit
scenarios.shock: Half of all miners leave on day 31

scenarios.name: Key crafters quit
scenarios.shock: Every smith in the North region quits on day 31

scenarios.name: Launch flood
scenarios.shock: Three times the population joins over 7 days

scenarios.name: Yield patch
scenarios.shock: A patch doubles grain yield from day 31

scenarios.name: Hoarding corner
scenarios.shock: 20 speculators with 25,000 coins each buy up Ironhold's iron ore

scenarios.name: Gold flood
scenarios.shock: A dupe bug gives 5% of players ten times the target money each

scenarios.name: Gold drought
scenarios.shock: Market tax raised to 8% for 30 days

scenarios.name: Bot farm
scenarios.shock: 200 bots mine iron ore in Ironhold 20 hours a day

scenarios.name: Night trough
scenarios.shock: None; spreads and market makers are compared between 3 to 6 AM and evenings

scenarios.name: Region cut off
scenarios.shock: Travel to and from the North is blocked for 14 days

scenarios.name: Slow obsolescence
scenarios.shock: From day 31 players stop buying bread (a better food replaced it)

scenarios.name: Exploit hunt
scenarios.shock: Speculators spike iron ingot prices in Port Town to draw caravans, then try to sell high

scenarios.name: Core swing
scenarios.shock: Dungeon runs halve for 15 days, then double for 15 days

scenarios.name: Healer shortage
scenarios.shock: Four in five healers switch to damage for 20 days

scenarios.name: Wilds patch
scenarios.shock: Dangerous-zone yields halve for 15 days, then rise 50% for 15 days
